text: Found it: in `middleware/proxy.go` both balancers index into an empty target slice (`randomBalancer.Next` / `roundRobinBalancer.Next`), so a balancer with no targets panics (index out of range / divide by zero), and the proxy handler then dereferences a nil target. I'm fixing it so `Next` returns nil for an empty target list and the middleware answers 503 Service Unavailable instead of panicking. ETA ~5 minutes (fix + full test suite check).

Fixed and verified: `middleware/proxy.go` — `randomBalancer.Next` and `roundRobinBalancer.Next` now return nil when the target list is empty (instead of panicking on index-out-of-range / divide-by-zero), and `ProxyWithConfig` returns `echo.ErrServiceUnavailable` (503) when the balancer yields no target. Full suite passes, no pre-existing test broken.

On it: looking at `router.go` route lookup/backtracking for the no-routable-path case (panic / wrong 404-405 instead of a clean not-found). I'll have the fix plus a full-suite regression check in about 10 minutes.
#1 is fixed and verified (proxy balancers with no targets no longer panic; the middleware returns 503). Full test suite passes.
#2 is still in progress: the router fix is being worked out and regression-checked against the full suite. ETA ~8 minutes.

#4: `context.go`'s `Scheme()` returns the raw `X-Forwarded-Proto` value even when it isn't a valid scheme, so bogus values are used instead of falling through to `X-Forwarded-Protocol` / `http`. Fixing it to only accept http/https (case-insensitive) and otherwise fall back. ETA ~10 minutes.

#4 fixed and verified: `context.go`'s `Scheme()` now only accepts `http`/`https` (case-insensitive) from `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `X-Forwarded-Protocol` and `X-Url-Scheme`; invalid values are ignored and it falls through (ultimately to `http`), while valid values are returned verbatim. Full suite: no regressions, no pre-existing test broken.

#5: in `bind.go`'s `bindData`, the map branch always stores only the first value of each `[]string` as a string, so binding into a `map[string][]string` panics and other map value types are wrong. Fixing it to support map[string][]string / map[string]string / map[string]interface{} (and error on unsupported map types). ETA ~8 minutes.
#1 done (proxy balancers with no targets: no panic, 503 returned; verified).
#2 still in progress: router no-routable-path fix is being implemented and regression-checked. ETA ~5 minutes.
#4 done (context.go Scheme() ignores invalid forwarded scheme headers and falls back correctly; verified, no regressions).
#5 in progress: bind.go map binding fix (map[string][]string etc.) is being implemented and checked. ETA ~8 minutes.

#8: in `middleware/compress.go` the gzip/deflate middleware mishandles empty responses (it sets Content-Encoding / initialises the compressor even when there is no body, e.g. 204/empty body). Fixing so empty responses pass through untouched and never panic. ETA ~4 minutes.
#2 router.go: still in progress (subagent working on it, longer than expected). ETA ~4 minutes.
#7 group.go: in progress — the group middleware clobbering issue is being fixed and regression-checked. ETA ~6 minutes.
#8 compress.go: in progress (empty-body gzip handling). ETA ~4 minutes.
